component.name: AniMe Matrix
component.summary: Control the AniMe Matrix display of the ROG Strix Flare II Animate keyboard

description.p: GIF gallery, clock, effects, games, system monitor, notifications, schedule, animation editor and community library for the 312-LED display of the ASUS ROG Strix Flare II Animate keyboard.
The udev rule giving access to the keyboard must be installed on the host (see the README).
